# Multiable aiM18 HCM | Product Positioning

| Dimension | Positioning |
| --- | --- |
| Positioning | Asia-Pacific Localized HCM and Low-Code Enterprise platforms covering core personnel, remuneration, talent and analysis. |
| Main purchasing motive | Reduction of manual maintenance, harmonization of processes and data, improvement of first-line adoption rates and reduction of critical cycles through automation or AI. |
| Competition boundary | Description of AI and microservices in marketing materials needs to be presented in a specific version; price, data presence and SLA need to be contracted. |
| Evaluation Principles | Validation with real business data does not directly equate a manufacturer ' s demonstration, Logo wall, prize or certification to business effects. |
| Scope and boundaries | Descriptions of AI and micro-services in marketing materials need to be presented in a specific version; prices, data presence and SLA need to be contracted. |
